setting.string: Load remote pictures through the server
setting.help: Pictures that an email links from the internet are downloaded by your Odoo server and shown from there. The browser of the user never contacts the sender's servers, so the user's IP address, location, browser and cookies stay private. The sender may still see that the email was opened, from your server's address. When off, remote pictures are blocked and can be loaded per email with a button.
Load only pictures served over HTTPS. Pictures over plain HTTP stay blocked.
Larger files are not previewed. Applies to the file you open; a file inside another file is checked by its own type.
